title: First Look: Jalios, The Devilish Rogue
author: FaetoldSupportmaster

comments.author: Felfedezni
comments.body: Looks neat but painfully unplayable slow.

replies.author: FaetoldSupportmaster
replies.body:
I appreciate the feedback! 

Yes it’s slow right now but I’m hoping it’s for a few reasons that will resolve

- I’m using free compute while I develop, not actual paid tiers yet.
-This is also before any optimization (caching, prompt refinement, etc)
- I’m located in the eu, but I’m hosting in NA for now. That adds to the latency issue at least a bit haha
